description: The Rogue G2 (MY 2027) is Bowhead’s delta-style adaptive handcycle mountain bike, rebuilt around the new CYC Photon 2 motor system. Delivering 59% more torque (max. 135 Nm), 56% more battery range (max.1,560Wh), 100% more peak power (max.1,500W) and an integrated throttle, or “go button,” riders have extra power on hand whenever crank power isn’t enough, making it easier to start riding, keep up with the group, and finish the day feeling good.
